necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under reason code CO-197 for missing precertification. The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management.
